verdict.rationale: Aider is a locally-run, open-source CLI/Python tool (pip install, runs on your own machine with your own git repo and choice of LLM including local models via Ollama), so the 'core product' is inherently self-hosted with no mandatory SaaS backend. missing for 10: no explicit self-hosting/deployment guide or license discussion, and no independent corroboration of running fully offline/self-hosted at scale.
